rulesTestNames: reads a named resource only when the account's work list reaches it
lets the communications duty read every function label, nothing else
read: an account gets a named resource when its programAccessViews work list reaches it, and lists a kind (query on programId and kind) when the list reaches every one; the communications duty also gets and lists every function label, for photo album names; never while deleted
write: server only; written from programPickupPoints, programHotels and programFunctions
migrationNotes: Labels only, as getProgramWorkAccess returns them. A hotel's reception contact and notes, a function's venue notes, location, instructions and dress code, and a pickup point's coordinates and instructions are never copied. The program-work-views copy-forward migration creates views for resources that predate the triggers.
No personal data: nothing for account deletion to scrub; archive anonymization reaches the views through the source triggers.
